# hrui_dhcp_snooping (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving global DHCP Snooping status and trusted DHCP server ports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hrui_dhcp_snooping" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether global DHCP Snooping is enabled on the switch.
- `trusted_ports` (List of String) List of switch ports configured as trusted DHCP server ports.
